purpose: Oliv Finance integration specification — what HotelsVendors needs from Oliv to go live
executive_summary: HotelsVendors acts as a commission-based referral middleware for Oliv Finance. This document lists the API endpoints, webhook secrets, and technical requirements Oliv must provide for the integration to work.

section_1_oliv_api_endpoints_required.description: API endpoints Oliv must expose for HotelsVendors to call

endpoints.name: Supplier Onboarding / KYC Pre-fill
endpoints.purpose: Send supplier KYC data to Oliv for e-KYC registration
endpoints.when_called: When supplier completes HotelsVendors signup and clicks 'Activate Oliv Financing'
endpoints.request_body: Supplier CR data, tax ID, signatory info, bank account (see layer3-crm-attribution.ts)

endpoints.name: Invoice Factoring Request
endpoints.purpose: Submit an invoice for factoring with referral token
endpoints.when_called: When supplier clicks 'Factor via Oliv' on HotelsVendors dashboard
endpoints.request_body: ETA UUID, supplier tax ID, hotel tax ID, invoice total, referral token (see layer1-referral-token.ts)

endpoints.name: Credit Facility Status
endpoints.purpose: Check supplier's available credit balance and utilization
endpoints.when_called: When supplier views their credit facility dashboard on HotelsVendors

endpoints.name: Payment Schedule
endpoints.when_called: When supplier views payment schedule on HotelsVendors dashboard

endpoints.name: ETA Invoice Lookup
endpoints.purpose: Oliv queries ETA portal to validate invoice
endpoints.when_called: During factoring assessment (this is Oliv's internal call, but HotelsVendors needs to know Oliv will use the UUID)
endpoints.note: Oliv already has this — no action needed from HotelsVendors

section_2_oliv_webhooks_required.description: Webhooks Oliv must send to HotelsVendors when events occur

endpoints.name: Payout Status Callback
endpoints.when_sent: Oliv sends this when payout status changes (APPROVED → DISBURSED → SETTLED)
required_payload_fields: referralToken (the full token HotelsVendors sent — MUST be echoed back)
endpoints.hotelsvendors_response: 200 OK with {success: true, transactionId, platformFee, netDisbursement}

endpoints.name: Credit Facility Update
endpoints.when_sent: Oliv sends this when supplier's credit limit changes (approved, increased, suspended, defaulted)

endpoints.name: KYC Status Update
endpoints.when_sent: Oliv sends this when supplier's KYC status changes (submitted → approved → credit approved)

section_3_secrets_hotelsvendors_needs_fr.description: Secrets and credentials Oliv must provide for secure communication

items.name: Oliv Webhook Signing Secret
items.purpose: HotelsVendors uses this to verify that callbacks actually come from Oliv (prevents spoofed webhooks)
items.how_to_share: Secure channel only (not email). Use 1Password, Vault, or encrypted message.

items.name: Oliv API Key / Bearer Token
items.purpose: HotelsVendors uses this to authenticate when calling Oliv's onboarding, factoring, and credit endpoints

items.name: Oliv HMAC Secret for Request Signing
items.purpose: HotelsVendors signs every request to Oliv with this secret. Oliv verifies the signature to ensure requests are authentic.
items.note: HotelsVendors generates its own HMAC secret and shares the public key with Oliv. Or Oliv generates and shares.

section_4_oliv_crm_fields_mandatory.description: Fields Oliv MUST write into their CRM/ERP during supplier KYC creation. These are non-deletable attribution fields.

fields.why: Identifies HotelsVendors as the referring partner for commission tracking
Ensures any future manual entry of this Tax ID by Oliv agents triggers the commission pool
Identifies the integration version for future reference

section_4_oliv_crm_fields_mandatory.oliv_commitment_required: Oliv must confirm these fields are written during KYC creation and cannot be overwritten by Oliv agents manually

section_5_data_oliv_needs_from_hotelsven.description: What HotelsVendors will send to Oliv (already built, just listing for confirmation)

data_sent: Company legal name, CR number, tax ID, address
Signatory name, national ID, position, contact

section_6_oliv_obligations_for_anti_bypa.description: Technical obligations Oliv must agree to for the anti-bypass architecture to work

obligations.obligation: Oliv MUST echo the HotelsVendors referral token on every payout callback
obligations.why: Without this token, HotelsVendors cannot verify the transaction originated from our platform
obligations.enforcement: HotelsVendors webhook rejects callbacks without valid token (403 Forbidden)

obligations.obligation: Oliv MUST store partner_id=HOTELSVENDORS_GLOBAL_001 in their CRM for every supplier onboarded through HotelsVendors
obligations.why: Commission tracking — proves the supplier was referred by HotelsVendors
obligations.enforcement: Contractual obligation + audit trail in OlivOnboardingAudit table

obligations.obligation: Oliv MUST NOT process an ETA UUID for factoring without a valid HotelsVendors referral token
obligations.why: Prevents bypass — if Oliv processes an invoice without our token, it's a contract breach
obligations.enforcement: HotelsVendors monitors all transactions; missing token = unauthorized reconciliation alert

obligations.obligation: Oliv MUST send payout status callbacks to HotelsVendors before processing the disbursement internally
obligations.why: Ensures HotelsVendors is in the loop and can log the transaction for commission purposes

obligations.obligation: Oliv MUST confirm that partner_id and attribution_type cannot be manually overwritten by Oliv agents
obligations.why: Prevents commission fraud — if an Oliv agent manually removes the partner_id, the commission is lost

section_7_questions_for_oliv_meeting.description: Questions to ask Oliv during today's meeting

questions: Can you provide your OpenAPI/Swagger spec for the onboarding, factoring, and credit endpoints?
What authentication method do you use? (Bearer token, API key, OAuth2?)
Do you have a sandbox environment we can test against?
Can you send payout status callbacks to our endpoint?
What webhook signing method do you use? (HMAC-SHA256, RSA?)
Can you provide a webhook signing secret for us to verify callbacks?
Do you support idempotency keys on webhooks?
Can you confirm you will write partner_id and attribution_type into your CRM during KYC?
Can these fields be made non-deletable in your system?
How do you currently track partner referrals?
Can you provide a report of all suppliers referred by HotelsVendors?
Do you already query the ETA portal for invoice validation?
Can you use the HotelsVendors ETA UUID directly, or do you need additional data?
What is your process for frozen invoice reconciliation under FRA Decision No. 51/2026?
How do you currently calculate and pay partner commissions?
Can you confirm the 2% platform fee is deducted before disbursement?
What is your settlement cycle for partner commissions?
